'''Vishweshwaraiah Prakash''' is an Indian structural biologist, food technologist and a former director-general designate of the [[Council of Scientific and Industrial Research]] (CSIR).<ref name="Dr Vishweshwaraiah Prakash will be the new DG">{{cite web | url=http://www.nal.res.in/pages/ipnov06.htm | title=Dr Vishweshwaraiah Prakash will be the new DG | publisher=NAL | date=2015 | access-date=16 November 2015}}</ref> He is a former director of the [[Central Food Technological Research Institute]] (CFTRI), [[Mysore]]<ref name="Indian to head international food science and technology body">{{cite magazine | url=https://www.indiatoday.in/latest-headlines/story/indian-to-head-international-food-science-and-technology-body-31659-2008-10-15 | title=Indian to head international food science and technology body | magazine=India Today | date=15 October 2008 | access-date=16 November 2015}}</ref> and was involved with the [[International Union of Food Science and Technology]] as the chairman of its International Academy during 2008-10.<ref name="Presidents of the Academy (IAFoST)">{{cite web | url=http://www.iufost.org/academy-fellows | title=Presidents of the Academy (IAFoST) | publisher=International Union of Food Science and Technology | date=2015 | access-date=16 November 2015 | archive-date=5 November 2015 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151105040322/http://www.iufost.org/academy-fellows | url-status=dead }}</ref> He received the [[Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize]], the highest Indian award in the science and technology category in 1996.<ref name="Brief Profile of the Awardee">{{cite web | url=http://ssbprize.gov.in/content/Detail.aspx?AID=238 | title=Brief Profile of the Awardee | publisher=Council of Scientific and Industrial Research | date=2015 | access-date=16 November 2015}}</ref> The Government of India awarded him the fourth highest civilian honour of the [[Padma Shri]] in 2004,<ref name="Padma Awards">{{cite web | url=http://mha.nic.in/sites/upload_files/mha/files/LST-PDAWD-2013.pdf | title=Padma Awards | publisher=Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India | date=2015 | access-date=21 July 2015 | archive-date=15 October 2015 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151015193758/http://mha.nic.in/sites/upload_files/mha/files/LST-PDAWD-2013.pdf | url-status=dead }}</ref>

== Biography ==
Prakash was born in the south Indian state of [[Karnataka]] on 23 November 1951,<ref name="Brief Profile of the Awardee" /> graduated (BSc) from Mysore University and followed it up with a master's degree (MS) from the same institution.<ref name="Prakash Receives Lifetime Achievement Award">{{cite web | url=http://www.chemistryviews.org/details/ezine/5615361/Prakash_Receives_Lifetime_Achievement_Award.html | title=Prakash Receives Lifetime Achievement Award | publisher=Chemistry Views | date=19 November 2013 | access-date=16 November 2015}}</ref> Later, he secured his doctoral degree (PhD) from [[University of Mysore]] in 1976 and, obtaining a fellowship, he moved to US in 1976 and did post-doctoral research at [[Texas Medical Centre]] in Houston and [[Brandeis University]], Boston till 1980.<ref name="Prakash Receives Lifetime Achievement Award" /> He returned to India in 1981 and joined [[Council of Scientific and Industrial Research]] (CSIR) as a Pool Officer at their Mysore research unit, [[Central Food Technological Research Institute]] (CFTRI). He served the organization for several years and became its director in 1994.{{citation needed|date=February 2020}} He headed the centre for 13 years till his appointment as the director-general of CSIR in December 2006 and was supposed to take charge in January 2007, but did not assume office.<ref name="List of Former DGs">{{cite web | url=http://www.csir.res.in/Home.aspx?MenuId=2 | title=List of Former DGs | publisher=Council of Scientific and Industrial Research | date=2015 | access-date=16 November 2015 | url-status=dead | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160702134459/http://www.csir.res.in/Home.aspx?MenuId=2 | archive-date=2 July 2016 | df=dmy-all }}</ref> In 2008,<ref name="Indian to head international food science and technology body" /> he was selected as the president of the International Academy of the [[International Union of Food Science and Technology]] (IAFoST), a global association of food technologists and held the office till 2010.<ref name="Presidents of the Academy (IAFoST)" />

Prakash is known to have done extensive research in [[structural homology]] of seed proteins and the ''association-dissociation and denaturation profiles of these proteins''. His work is reported to have assisted in the understanding of the behaviour of several seed proteins from a stability perspective and revealed more about their structural biology.<ref name="Brief Profile of the Awardee" /> His research findings have been documented by way of over 200 articles published in CFTRI publications<ref name="Items where Author is Vishweshwaraiah, Prakash">{{cite web | url=http://ir.cftri.com/view/creators/Vishweshwaraiah=3APrakash=3A=3A.default.html | title=Items where Author is "Vishweshwaraiah, Prakash" | publisher=CFTRI | date=2015 | access-date=16 November 2015}}</ref> and other peer reviewed national and international journals.<ref name="PUBLICATIONS AUTHORED BY VISHWESHWARAIAH PRAKASH">{{cite web | url=http://www.pubfacts.com/author/Vishweshwaraiah+Prakash | title=PUBLICATIONS AUTHORED BY VISHWESHWARAIAH PRAKASH | publisher=Pubfacts | date=2015 | access-date=16 November 2015}}</ref> His researches are known to have wide-ranging applications in commercial food industry and he holds 50 patents,<ref name="Dr Vishweshwaraiah Prakash receives Lifetime Achievement Award">{{cite web | url=http://www.soci.org/news/awards/other/vishweshwaraiah-prakash | title=Dr Vishweshwaraiah Prakash receives Lifetime Achievement Award | publisher=SCI | date=6 December 2013 | access-date=16 November 2015}}</ref> some of them on preserved sugar cane juice, coconut sap ([[Neera]]) and baked snacks.<ref name="Patents by Inventor Vishweshwaraiah Prakash">{{cite web | url=http://patents.justia.com/inventor/vishweshwaraiah-prakash | title=Patents by Inventor Vishweshwaraiah Prakash | publisher=Justia Patents | date=2015 | access-date=16 November 2015}}</ref> Besides, he has written six books and 20 review chapters;<ref name="High Level Panel of Experts on Food Security and Nutrition (HLPE) ">{{cite web | url=http://www.fao.org/fileadmin/user_upload/hlpe/hlpe_documents/PT_Food_Losses/Docs/HLPE_Food_Losses_Waste_Team_3-September-2013_DEF.pdf | title=High Level Panel of Experts on Food Security and Nutrition (HLPE) | publisher=Food and Agriculture Organization | date=3 September 2013 | access-date=17 November 2015}}</ref> ''Leafy spices'', a reference guide on the botanical and agricultural aspects of agro-products yielding essential oils of leafy spices, is one among them.<ref name="Leafy spices">{{cite book | url=https://books.google.com/books?id=GSgjAQAAMAAJ | title=Leafy spices | publisher=CRC Press | author=Vishweshwaraiah Prakash | year=1990 | pages=114 | isbn=9780849367236}}</ref> During his tenure as the head of CFTRI, he established the ''Advanced School of Protein Chemistry and Technology'', for advanced research.<ref name="Indian to head international food science and technology body" /> His contributions are also reported behind the CFTRI initiative to supply 200,000 food packages to the victims of the [[2004 Indian Ocean earthquake and tsunami]] that hit the Indian coasts, along with other areas.<ref name="Indian to head international food science and technology body" />

Prakash serves as the president of two major food-related organizations, namely, the International Society of Nutraceuticals And Nutritionals (ISNAN),  and Indian Academy of Nutraceuticals and Nutritionals (IANAN), and is a former president of the Nutrition Society of India (NSI).<ref name="OFFICE BEARERS">{{cite web | url=http://www.nutritionsocietyindia.org/Download_files/OfficeBearers.pdf | title=OFFICE BEARERS | publisher=Nutrition Society of India | date=2015 | access-date=17 November 2015}}</ref> During his stint at CFTRI, he coordinated the activities of the [[United Nations University]] at the institution and chaired the ''[[Food and Agriculture Organization]] (FAO) panel on Food Losses and Food Wastes''<ref name="Jain International Residential School profile">{{cite web | url=http://www.jirs.ac.in/pdf/2013-14/Profile-DrVPrakash.pdf | title=Jain International Residential School profile | publisher=Jain International Residential School | date=2015 | access-date=17 November 2015}}</ref> 
as well as the ''FAO High Level Panel of Experts on Food Security and Nutrition'' (HLPE).<ref name="High Level Panel of Experts on Food Security and Nutrition (HLPE) " /> He serves as a member of the Editorial Board of ''Comprehensive Reviews in Food Science and Food Safety'', a journal published by the [[Institute of Food Technologists]],<ref name="Comprehensive Reviews in Food Science and Food Safety">{{cite journal | title=Comprehensive Reviews in Food Science and Food Safety | journal=Institute of Food Technologists | date=May 2013 | volume=12 | issue=3 |pages = i| issn=1541-4337| doi=10.1111/j.1541-4337.2013.00206.x | doi-access=free }}</ref> chairs the Advisory Board of the NuFFooDS Magazine,<ref name="Jain International Residential School profile" /> and sits in the executive editorial Board of the ''Journal  of the Science of Food and Agriculture'', published by [[John Wiley & Sons]].<ref name="Executive editorial board">{{cite journal | url=http://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/journal/10.1002/(ISSN)1097-0010/homepage/EditorialBoard.html | title=Executive editorial board | publisher=Journal of the Science of Food and Agriculture | date=2015 | access-date=17 November 2015| doi=10.1002/(ISSN)1097-0010 | hdl=11390/1148750 | hdl-access=free | url-access=subscription }}</ref> He is an IUoFST visiting faculty at [[Saigon Technology University]] and an adjunct professor of Nutrition at the [[Tufts University]], Boston.<ref name="Jain International Residential School profile" /> He chairs the ''Task Force on Nutritionals  and [[Nutraceuticals]]''  of International  Union of Nutritional Sciences and Technology and the Research Advisory Committee of the [[Central Institute of Fisheries Technology]] (CIFT), Kochi. He is also a member-at-large of the Global Harmonization Initiative (GHI), a scientific community facilitating scientific advancement in food technology.<ref name="GHI Officers">{{cite web | url=http://www.globalharmonization.net/ghi_officers | title=GHI Officers | publisher=Global Harmonization Initiative | date=2015 | access-date=16 November 2015}}</ref>

== Awards and honours ==
[[Indian Academy of Sciences]] elected Prakash as their fellow in 1995<ref name="IAS Fellows">{{cite web | url=http://www.ias.ac.in/listing/fellows | title=IAS Fellows | publisher=Indian Academy of Sciences | date=2015 | access-date=17 November 2015}}</ref> and [[National Academy of Agricultural Sciences]] followed suit in 1998.<ref name="NAAS Fellow">{{cite web | url=http://naasindia.org/fdetail.html#P039 | title=NAAS Fellow | publisher=National Academy of Agricultural Sciences | date=2015 | access-date=17 November 2015}}</ref> The [[National Academy of Sciences, India]] honoured him with Fellowship in 2002<ref name="NASI Fellows">{{cite web | url=http://www.nasi.org.in/fellows.asp?RsFilter=P | title=NASI Fellows | publisher=National Academy of Sciences, India | date=2015 | access-date=17 November 2015 | archive-date=4 March 2016 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304044529/http://www.nasi.org.in/fellows.asp?RsFilter=P | url-status=dead }}</ref> and the next year, the [[Royal Society of Chemistry]] elected him as a [[Fellow of the Royal Society of Chemistry|Fellow]].<ref name="Jain International Residential School profile" /> He is also an elected Fellow of the [[International Union of Food Science and Technology]],<ref name="Presidents of the Academy (IAFoST)" /> [[Indian National Academy of Engineering]],<ref name="INAE Fellows">{{cite web | url=http://inae.in/fellowship-engineering-sections-i-to-x/#SECTION-IV | title=INAE Fellows | publisher=Indian National Academy of Engineering | date=2015 | access-date=17 November 2015}}</ref> Indian Academy of Social Sciences and the Association of Food Scientists  and Technologists, India (2008).<ref name="Jain International Residential School profile" /><ref name="NAAS Fellow" />

Prakash, a Distinguished Scientist of the [[Council of Scientific and Industrial Research]],<ref name="OFFICE BEARERS" /> is reported to have received over 55 awards including award lectures,<ref name="Jain International Residential School profile" /> starting with the 1988 Golden Jubilee Award of [[Mysore University]], followed by ''P. S. Sarma Memorial Award'' of the Society of Biological Chemists (India) in 1989<ref name="P. S. Sarma Memorial Award">{{cite web | url=http://www.iisc.ernet.in/sbci/psmaward.html | title=P. S. Sarma Memorial Award | publisher=Society Of Biological Chemists | date=2015 | access-date=17 November 2015}}</ref> and ''Laljee Godhoo Smarak Nidhi Award'' of the Association of Food Scientists  and Technologists, India in 1992.<ref name="NAAS Fellow" /> He was awarded the [[Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize]] of the CSIR, the highest Indian science award, in 1996<ref name="Brief Profile of the Awardee" /> and the Government of Karnataka awarded him the second highest civilian award of the state, [[Rajyotsava Prashasthi]], the same year.<ref name="Jain International Residential School profile" /> He received the Indian Independence Golden Jubilee Award in 1997 and two awards, Prof. V. Subramanyan Industrial Achievement Award and CFTRI Best Alumnus Award, in 1999. All India Food Processors' Association (AIFPA) honoured him with Soilendra Krishna Mitra Memorial Award in 2000 and the year 2001 brought him two more awards, DuPont Protein Technologies International Award and [[Federation of Indian Chambers of Commerce & Industry|FICCI]] Award in Life Sciences and Agriculture, followed by Kashalkar Memorial Award in 2003.<ref name="NAAS Fellow" />

The Government of India included Prakash in the 2004 [[Indian honours system|Republic Day honours]] list for the civilian honour of the [[Padma Shri]].<ref name="Padma Awards" /> The Government of Karnataka honoured him again with ''Lifetime Achievement Award'' in 2012<ref name="NAAS Fellow" /> and the Lifetime Achievement Award of SCI, UK reached him in 2013,<ref name="Dr Vishweshwaraiah Prakash receives Lifetime Achievement Award" /> the same year as he received the Lifetime Achievement Award of the [[International Union of Food Science and Technology]].<ref name="Prakash Receives Lifetime Achievement Award" /> 38th B.C. Guha Memorial Lecture Award of the [[Indian Science Congress]] (2001), 6th Golden Jubilee Commemorative Talk Award of the [[Central Institute of Fisheries Technology]] (2007), 19th Srikantia Memorial Lecture Award of Nutrition Society of India (2007), C. Ramachandran Memorial Lecture Award of NFI (2007) and Dr. Rajammal P. Devdas's Oration Lecture Award of the [[Avinashilingam University for Women]], (2009) are some of the notable orations delivered by him.<ref name="NAAS Fellow" />
